We are asked: Does the value of `is` used at line 34 depend on the value of `os` at line 13? That is, does the value of `is` (which is an InputStream) at the point of line 34 depend on the value assigned to `os` at line 13? The value of `is` is assigned at line 12 from `getInputStream()`. There is no assignment to `is` after that. The value of `os` is assigned at line 13. The value of `is` is not derived from `os` in any way. The only interaction is that `is` and `os` are used together in the loop and in `closeStreams`, but that does not change the value of `is`. The value of `is` remains the same object reference obtained from `getInputStream()`. It does not depend on `os`. Even if `os` were different, `is` would still be the same. So the value of `is` at line 34 does not depend on the value of `os` at line 13.

Thus, answer is No.
